statement_en: Let $f\in \mathbb{C}[x]$ be a monic polynomial with $m$ distinct roots, and let $c>0$ be a constant small enough such that $\{ z: \lvert f(z)\rvert\leq c\}$ has $m$ distinct connected components. Must all these components be convex?
